purpose: Official-source comparators for NYSC COURSE-045 Welder. No governed module headings are published, so records are shown without a competency matrix.
status_note: Source-inspected records awaiting independent human review; standards, curricula and qualifications are not evidence of programme delivery.

records.institution: Tertiary and Vocational Education Commission / National Apprentice and Industrial Training Authority
records.level_as_published: NVQ Levels 2, 3 and 4 across process-specific packages

modules.title_verbatim: Practice occupational health and safety procedures in a welding workshop
Cut steel by Oxy-acetylene / Oxy fuel flame
Weld steel plates by Manual Metal Arc Welding (MMAW) In flat position (1G and 1F)
Weld steel pipes by Manual Metal Arc Welding (MMAW) in 1G,2G,5G,6G positions
Perform soldering and brazing
Weld steel plates by Metal Active Gas (MAG) welding in all (1F-4F,1G-4G) positions
Weld steel plates by Flux Cored Arc Welding (FCAW) process in 1G-3G positions
Weld stainless steel plates by Tungsten Inert Gas (TIG) welding in all (1F-4F, 1G-4G) positions
Cut metal by plasma cutting process
Perform spot welding

verification.method: Process-specific NVQ packaging and selected competency-unit codes/titles were checked against the official 160-page NCS/CBT curriculum PDF.

notes: An occupational standard, not evidence that a named provider delivers the programme.
The standard defines separate qualification packages by welding process and level; it is not one mandatory 27-unit programme.
scope_verbatim: Layout, fit, and fabricate metal components to assemble structural forms, such as machinery frames, piping, and pressure vessels, of ferrous and non-ferrous materials, using knowledge of welding techniques, metallurgy, and engineering requirements.

records.institution: Directorate General of Training (DGT), Ministry of Skill Development & Entrepreneurship
records.duration_as_published: One year (1200 Hours + 150 hours OJT/Group Project)

modules.title_verbatim: Set the gas welding plant and join MS sheet in different position following safety precautions.
Set the SMAW machine and perform different type of joints on MS in different position observing standard procedure.
Set the oxy- acetylene cutting plant and perform different cutting operations on MS plate.
Choose appropriate welding process and perform joining of different types of metals and check its correctness.
Test welded joints by different methods of testing.
Set GMAW machine and perform welding in different types of joints on MS sheet/plate by GMAW in various positions by dip mode of metal transfer.
Set the GTAW machine and perform welding by GTAW in different types of joints on different metals in different position and check correctness of the weld.
Set the Plasma Arc cutting machine and cut ferrous & non-ferrous metals.

verification.method: General information and selected trade-specific learning outcomes were read from the official DGT curriculum PDF.
